long_biography.plain_text:
Yacht-brokerage executive Bob Denison's first sale began with an email from a buyer in New Jersey. They met only when the customer collected his boat, then kept in touch and completed further purchases. That experience encouraged Denison to build relationships online as well as through traditional boat shows.

He also made marketing activity more visible to sellers. His company's Owner's Dashboard let clients and listing brokers monitor website views, email clicks, social-media engagement and video audiences. Having stopped selling boats himself, he concentrated on marketing and management, supporting brokers without competing for their customers.
